name: Mechanical Engineering
description: The Department of Mechanical Engineering at AIKTC delivers an intensive, hands-on engineering education that integrates core principles of mechanics, thermodynamics, fluid dynamics, and materials science with modern computational design (CAD/CAM/CAE), mechatronics, and advanced manufacturing. The department is renowned for experiential engineering, where students actively design, fabricate, and test racing vehicles (Formula Student / FSAE), autonomous robotics, and sustainable HVAC energy systems. Students acquire strong competencies in 3D Modeling (SolidWorks, CATIA), Finite Element Analysis (ANSYS), and precision CNC manufacturing.
highlights: Approved intake of 60 seats affiliated with the University of Mumbai, emphasizing hands-on design and mechanical prototyping.

Comprehensive laboratory infrastructure spanning 12+ specialized labs including CNC Milling/Lathe Workshop, Heat Transfer & RAC Lab, Fluid Mechanics & Hydraulic Machinery Lab, IC Engines Lab, and CAD/CAM Simulation Suite.
Active student racing team representing AIKTC in Formula Bharat, BAJA SAE, and national robotic competitions.
Broad career placements across automotive (Mahindra, Tata Motors), heavy engineering (L&T, Godrej), HVAC/energy systems, and aerospace supply chains.
career_opportunities: Mechanical Design Engineer (CAD/CAE), Thermal Systems Engineer, Manufacturing/Production Engineer, Automotive Engineer, Mechatronics Specialist, Quality Control (QC/QA) Engineer, and Project Engineer.
vision: To be the most sought after academic, research and practice based department of Mechanical Engineering that others would wish to emulate.
